functions.name: dext.bank
functions.description: Classify an observed bank label using the active registered client full bank reference. Production mode transmits the label/reference to the configured Gemini accounting model for the analysis explicitly requested by the user. Returns compte or null; never writes to Dext.

functions.name: dext.scribe
functions.description: Analyze a newly completed local PDF from Downloads using its exact filename or absolute path and the active registered client full achat/vente reference. The trusted host resolves the absolute path. Production analysis sends the actual PDF and full reference to Gemini for the analysis explicitly requested by the user. Returns a validated accounting proposal; never writes to Dext.
